Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Brightwell Health

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for a great conversation earlier today - glad Brightwell is exploring Redwood for inference serving. Per our security discussion, I'm initiating the SIG Lite questionnaire so your security team can validate our controls. I've attached the SIG Lite request PDF that you mentioned.

Next steps I suggest:
- Alex/security team: attach completed SIG Lite (or indicate preferred format: CAIQ or custom)
- Camila: review responses and loop in security for clarifying Qs
- Marissa: prepare the standard SOC 2 summary / evidence exports if requested

Clarifying questions for your team (so we can route to the right internal owners):
1) Will Brightwell need a signed BAA (HIPAA) or is a SOC 2 report + technical controls sufficient for initial procurement?
2) Any specific data residency requirements (US-only region)?
3) Do you need us to list subcontractors/vendors for cross-check?
4) Preferred delivery method for evidence (DocuSign, shared Drive link, or encrypted SFTP)?

I've CCed Marissa from our compliance team. I'll follow up with internal owners when your team returns the questionnaire.

Attachments: Brightwell_SIG_Lite_Request.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Camila,

Thanks - appreciate the clear next steps. I'm looping in our security mailbox and our security lead (copied) who will own the SIG. We'll try to complete SIG Lite and return it this week.

Quick answers to your clarifying Qs to reduce back-and-forth:
- BAA: For initial eval a SOC 2 report + controls is fine, but if we progress to a pilot involving PHI we will require a BAA.
- Data residency: US-only data storage is preferred; we'll note exceptions where necessary.
- Subcontractors: yes please list major subprocessors (e.g., cloud providers, telemetry vendors).
- Evidence delivery: Secure Drive link or SFTP works best for us.

We'll return the completed SIG Lite and flag any items that require deeper evidence.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Senior Procurement Manager, Brightwell Health

Appreciate the quick response, Alex - and thanks for the guidance. A couple of follow-ups from our side while your team completes the SIG Lite:

1) SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026-12-31. I've attached a one-page SOC 2 summary for your team to review. If you need the full report we can coordinate an NDA and evidence transfer.

2) PHI/BAA: Understood on the BAA requirement for PHI. For clarity - Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment option and an executed BAA. If Brightwell expects PHI in the pilot, we'll loop Legal to start BAA discussions early.

3) Subprocessors: short list we typically share initially - AWS (in-region), Datadog, Sentry, and our managed inference partner(s). We can provide a complete subprocessor list in the response spreadsheet.

4) Evidence transfer: we can provide secure Drive links for exports or SFTP - which do you prefer?

5) Timeline ask: to help our CS/prod teams plan, can you share your internal procurement timeline (target PO / pilot start)?

I'll start filling the SIG Lite response workbook for the common-control answers and will flag any items that require Naomi or Marissa.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (stub)

Best,
Camila

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Brightwell Health

Hi Alex / Brightwell security team - Naomi from Redwood security here. Thanks for taking the SIG Lite. A few quick clarifications while your team completes it:

- Encryption: All data in transit is TLS 1.2+; at-rest encryption uses AES-256 with customer-managed KMS available on Private deployments.
- SOC 2 evidence: happy to provide the SOC 2 Type II report under standard NDA + access controls; the one-page summary Camila attached covers scope and key control areas.
- Pen testing: we run annual 3rd-party penetration tests and perform quarterly internal red team exercises.
- Subprocessors list: we'll include the full list in the spreadsheet; for SIG Lite we'll add the major vendors in the initial tab.
- Data residency: Hosted option runs in multi-region public clouds; Dedicated/Private deployments can be restricted to US-only regions per contract.

Preferred evidence transfer: secure Drive link is our most common flow; we can also set up a one-time SFTP if you prefer.

If you have any specific control IDs you'd like us to call out in more detail (e.g., incident response playbooks, encryption key rotation cadence), send them over and I'll assign owners.

Naomi Feldman
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
